$themes.name: Light
$themes.$description: The light painted surface — gumroad.com's default under light colour schemes: a warm off-white ground (#f4f4f0), black ink, the pink accent (#ff90e8), hard 4px offset shadows.

$themes.name: Dark
$themes.$description: The dark painted surface: @media (prefers-color-scheme:dark) re-points the channel roles — #242423 ground, #ddd ink, the pink accent unchanged, borders fade to alpha .35 and the hard shadows flip to light. Painted by the OS/browser scheme; no in-page toggle.
